public_rationale: On the ordinary reading of the analogy, the companies offered differentiated alternatives for overlapping assistant, coding, and professional-work needs. Same-week product announcements and independent reporting establish direct competition. This supports the broad market comparison; it does not establish equal capabilities or identical customer mixes.
limitations: The result depends on reading the analogy at the level of core uses and competing products.
Product announcements establish intended functions, not independently verified performance.
The degree of similarity and strength of customer loyalty are not quantified.

our_interpretation: Read the analogy as describing differentiated alternatives in substantially overlapping assistant, coding, and knowledge-work markets.
Do not interpret 'slightly different' as numerical performance parity or identical product portfolios.
Treat 'loyal fans' as ordinary brand preference rather than a specified retention-rate claim.
Use the week of the post, February 2–8, 2026, matching its discussion of this week's competition and Super Bowl campaigns.
criteria.support_condition: The companies offer broadly substitutable products for core assistant, coding, and professional-work tasks and demonstrably compete for overlapping users.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Their principal offerings and intended customers occupy substantially separate markets, or their core functions are too different to be practical alternatives under this ordinary reading.
